plan.notes: Official 'Generic Program Course Progression' for the two-year generic Registered Nursing program, from the College of the Canyons Nursing Student Handbook, Spring 2024 edition (the current handbook on the live site; a Spring 2025 edition exists only on the college's outest test site). Transcribed 2026-10-02; every course number, title, and unit value copied verbatim. Four semesters; total_credits 39.0 = sequenced sum (10.75+9.5+10.25+8.5), matching the handbook's 'RN PROGRAM (#1650) Total Units: 39'. The handbook prints the course prefix as both 'NURSING' and 'NURSNG' (e.g. 'NURSING 112' vs 'NURSNG 126'); seeded as 'NURSNG' per the official 2024-2025 ADN RN major sheet, which uses NURSNG throughout for the identical course list and unit values. Program admission prerequisites (completed before the professional phase, not term-sequenced in the handbook, hence external to this plan): English 101, Anatomy (4 semester units), Physiology (4), Microbiology (4), Math 060 Elementary Algebra, minimum 2.50 GPA; PSYC 101 (or equivalent) must be completed prior to the second semester as prerequisite to NURSNG 126. Students also enroll in noncredit NC.NURS-080 skills-lab support (0 degree units, not sequenced). The LVN-to-RN Advanced Placement progression in the same handbook is explicitly marked 'Tentative: subject to clinical availability' and is not collected. Program-type gate: professional-phase (4 terms), justified by the handbook's cohort progression design.

courses.choice_note: Psychology 101 (or equivalent) must be completed prior to the second semester per the official program requirements.
